verdict.rationale: Maritime documents official TypeScript and Python SDKs for giving each user their own agent, with a dedicated SDK doc section. That section covers an idempotent `provision` call keyed on `externalId`, messaging that wakes sleeping agents, signed lifecycle webhooks, scoped-key authentication, and a Files API exposed through both SDKs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the SDKs work as documented, SDK package names/install instructions and versioning details in the evidence.
